audience: SEO teams that track keyword rankings and search visibility in AccuRanker

useCases.title: Find keywords that moved up
useCases.text: List the filter names first, then search the keywords of one domain with rank filters, such as a rank below four.

useCases.title: Read share of voice for a domain
useCases.text: Get one domain with its daily history of average rank and share of voice for a date range.

useCases.title: Compare landing pages by traffic value
useCases.text: List the landing pages of a domain with their rank history and traffic value for a date range.

useCases.title: Review keyword tags and saved segments
useCases.text: List the keyword tags of a domain with their history, and the saved segments you can apply to a keyword search.
